questions.title: How to Drop the Ball the Right Way
questions.question: If your golf ball goes somewhere tricky and you need to drop a new one, how are you supposed to let it go?

choices.text: Let the ball fall from your knee
Let the ball fall from your shoulder
Put the ball on the ground with your hand
Toss the ball up from your knee

questions.explanation: You should hold the ball at your knee and let it fall straight down. That is the proper way to drop a golf ball.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Let go of the ball and let it fall to the ground, not throw or roll it.
How high your knee is from the ground when you are standing.

questions.teachingTip: Show kids how high their knee is and practise letting the ball fall straight down without bouncing it or throwing it.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids might think they have to throw the ball down hard.
Some might want to drop it from high up, like their shoulder.
Some might want to just place the ball on the ground.

questions.title: Correct way to drop a ball
questions.question: According to the Rules of Golf, how should you drop a ball when taking relief?

choices.text: Let it fall from knee height
Let it fall from shoulder height
Place it gently on the ground by hand
Toss it upwards from knee height

questions.explanation: You need to drop the ball straight down from knee height so it falls through the air without touching you or your equipment.
